AlternativeKind.description: How an alternative part relates to a part (FR-PRT-004).

oneOf.description: Equivalent in form, fit and function.

AlternativeRef.description: A part that may replace another (FR-PRT-004).

kind.description: How it relates to this part.

BusSection.description:
The bus section of a part (`sections.bus`, doc 10 §2.6; WP-S1.21 D15): the part's bus interfaces. A part port
is carried by a function of the device whose function definition has contact kind `bus_port`; normaliser N5
gives a port-less such function the part's port once and never rewrites it (D16). The station address and the
nets belong to the drawn port ([`BusPort`]), not to the part.

ports.description:
The part's bus interfaces, in the part's order. The schema enforces no uniqueness: every reader takes the
first port of an (`interface`, `port_label`) pair and ignores later ones.

CableCore.description: One core of a cable part.

ChannelKind.description: The kind of a channel (doc 10 §2.4). `multi_function` (IO-Link port modes, 1.0) is additive.

ChannelSpec.description: The channels a module part instantiates.

data_type.description: The data type in the profile vocabulary ("Bool").

ChannelState.description: An explicit channel state (doc 10 §3.2); `used` is never stored, it is derived from the target.

ClampKey.description: The clamp of a terminal CP (doc 08 §2.3): `{"clamp": "a"}`, `{"shaft": 1}` or `"rail_foot"`.

oneOf.description: A wire clamp a, b, c ….
The rail foot of a PE terminal.

ClampType.description: The kind of a CP's clamp (FR-PRT-008, doc 12 §2.5).

Clearance.description: The clearance around a part (doc 12 §2.5), in nanometres; an absent side is zero.

ColourCode.description: An IEC 60757 or profile-declared company colour code, or {"foreign": code} (doc 05 §3.2).

Confidence.description: Confidence of one section of library data.

Configured.description: A configured product (FR-PRT-006): its order code and its components.

ConfiguredComponent.description: One component of a configured product (doc 07 §2.5 `Component`).

qty.description: The quantity in the component part's order unit.

ContactData.description: One contact of a part's contact image (FR-PRT-009, doc 07 §2.5).

cps.description: The designations of the contact's CPs, such as `["13", "14"]`.

kind.description: The contact kind, the function definitions' enum (`no`, `nc`, `co` for a change-over).

CpData.description:
One CP of a part's pattern (doc 07 §2.5, L1), with the clamp data of FR-PRT-008 (clamp type, cross-section
range, maximum conductors, twin-ferrule permission). The load current (1.0) is kept in `extra` until its
work package.

csa_max.description: The largest conductor cross-section the clamp takes, in mm².

csa_min.description: The smallest conductor cross-section the clamp takes, in mm².

max_conductors.description: The most conductors the clamp takes.

twin_ferrule.description: The clamp takes a twin ferrule.

Csa.description: A cross-section: a Dec3 string in mm², {"awg": n} or {"kcmil": Dec3} (doc 08 §4.6).

Dec3.description: A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

DuctSection.description: The duct section of a part (FR-PRT-024, doc 12 §2.5), lengths in nanometres.

EnclosureSection.description: The enclosure section of a part (FR-PRT-024, doc 12 §2.5), lengths in nanometres.

FreeProp.description: A free property (EPLAN free properties, user fields).

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

IoClass.description: The address class of an I/O range (the profile keeps one allocation cursor per class).

IoDir.description: The direction of an I/O range.

IoRange.description: One I/O range of a part.

ItemMeta.description:
Provenance of a library item (doc 07 §2.1, §2.5). The item's semantic version is the copy metadata
`version` of the [`LibCopy`] and is stored once, there.

confidence.description: Confidence per section, keyed by section name.

licence.description: SPDX licence expression of the item.

sources.description: Where the data came from: datasheet references, file hashes, manual entry.

LibRef.description: A reference between library items (doc 07 §2.1): library, item and a semantic-version requirement.

item.description: The item's UUID, stable across versions.

MacroLink.description: The macro of a part for one representation type (FR-PRT-027).

MapSpec.description: A part-data map (doc 10 §2.6): an expression "<k>n[+<c>]" or "<k>p[+<c>]", or an explicit list.

MechData.description: Mechanical data of a part, level L3 (FR-PRT-011, doc 12 §2.5): lengths in nanometres, the mass in grams.

clearance.description: The clearance kept free around the part.

front_2d.description: The 2D front outline: polylines in the part frame.

rail_offset.description: The vector from the rail pose to the part origin, `[x, y]` in nanometres.

MlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

MountKind.description: How a part mounts (doc 12 §2.5); also the profile of a rail section.

Nm.description: A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

OnOff.description: A two-state switch (doc 10 §2.7: the termination of a connector, FR-BUS-004).

oneOf.description: Metre, written `m` like the unit of a `Quantity` (doc 05 §3.2).

PartBusPort.description:
One bus interface of a part (WP-S1.21 D15): the first four members as in [`BusPort`]. No address, net,
connector, signal map or address range is typed; those stay in `extra` (1.0).

port_label.description: The port label of a multi-port interface ("P1R").

role.description: The role a port made from this interface takes.

termination.description: Present: the interface has a termination switch, in this state; absent: it has none.

PartSections.description:
Domain sections of a part (FR-PRT-010). Typed: the cable cores, the PLC section and the carrier sections of
FR-PRT-024 (enclosure, duct, rail, mounting plate); the other sections stay in `extra`.

bus.description: The bus section: the part's bus interfaces (doc 10 §2.6, WP-S1.21 D15).

cable_cores.description: Cores of a cable part, from which conductors are generated (FR-CBL-004).

duct.description: The duct section: inner dimensions and slot pitch.

enclosure.description: The enclosure section: outer and wall dimensions and the mounting plate (doc 12 §2.5).

rail.description: The rail section: profile and stock length.

PinMap.description: A channel → pin map (doc 10 §3.3): a designation pattern with `{<expression in n>}` placeholders ("X2:{n+1}"), or an explicit list of pin designations.

PlateSection.description: The mounting-plate section of a part (FR-PRT-024, doc 12 §2.5), lengths in nanometres.

PlcRole.description: The PLC role of a part.

PlcSection.description:
The PLC section of a part (doc 10 §2.6, level L2 part data). The supply groups, earth, bus ports and the
`meta` confidence are additive and stay in `extra` until their work packages.

bit_of.description:
The channel map: channel number → bit offset in the module's range (doc 10 §2.6, "n", "16n" or a
list); absent: linear.

io.description: The I/O ranges the part occupies.

pin_of.description:
The channel → pin map of a module with physical pins (doc 10 §3.3, normaliser N3): channel number →
the designation of the module's connection point ("X2:{n+1}", or a list); absent: the channels have
no pins (internal channels, such as the solenoid outputs of a valve-terminal module).

positions.description:
The solenoid-position map of a valve-terminal module (doc 10 §2.6 `[plc.positions]`, §3.2 step 4,
§3.3 normaliser N2); absent: the module serves no valve positions.

role.description: What the part is in the PLC model.

unbound.description: The state of channels neither bound nor claimed (doc 10 §3.2); absent: spare.

PortRole.description: The role of a bus port (doc 10 §2.7).

oneOf.description: A passive element without an address: a bus connector.

PositionMap.description:
The solenoid-position map of a valve-terminal module part (doc 10 §2.6 `[plc.positions]`): the channel
that each solenoid of the valve at position index `p` drives. The position index is 0-based: the valve
child at `Device.position` = q sits at p = q − 1 (doc 11 §3.2). Part 533361 of Golden A carries the test
input H1, `count = 4`, solenoid 14 → `2p`, solenoid 12 → `2p+1` (doc 20 §11.2).

count.description: The number of valve positions (p = 0 … count − 1).

map.description: One entry per solenoid name, in part-data order.

Pt2.description: A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

RailSection.description: The rail section of a part (FR-PRT-024, doc 12 §2.5).

RepType.description:
Representation types (doc 03 §6, doc 07 §2.3). `panel_front` is a symbol type only: panel-front
representations are derived, never stored (ADR-0006 amendment 3).

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest sha256:<64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Side.description:
A terminal side (doc 08 §2.1: side 1 is internal and side 2 external unless `Strip.field_side` says
otherwise).

SolenoidChannel.description: One entry of a [`PositionMap`]: the channel of one solenoid as a function of the position index.

channel.description: The channel number at position index p: a `p` expression ("2p", "2p+1") or a list indexed by p.

solenoid.description: The solenoid ("14", "12"), matched against the designation of the valve's coil CP.

anyOf.description: An identifier such as the tripping curve `C`.

TechVal.description:
The value of a [`TechValue`], told apart by JSON type: an object is a [`Quantity`], a string an
[`Ident`]. Any other JSON type is kept as [`TechVal::Unknown`]; an object that is not a quantity or a
string that is not an identifier is a malformed variant (`quantity`, `ident`).

TechValue.description:
One technical value (doc 05 §3.2 `TechValue`): `{"key", "value"}` whose value is a [`Quantity`] or an
[`Ident`], told apart by JSON type.

key.description: The property key, such as `i_out` or `curve`.

TemplateFn.description: One function of a part's template (FR-PRT-007).

main.description: The main function of the part.

Unit.description:
The units of doc 03 §3.2 and the order units of FR-PRT-026. Persisted as the unit symbol in ASCII
(`"mm2"`, `"degC"`), so files stay greppable; rendering uses the typographic symbol.

oneOf.description: Metre (lengths and the order unit of cables).

Vec2Nm.description: An offset [dx, dy] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2): a vector, not a position.

description:
An embedded library copy (doc 07 §2.1, doc 05 §13.2): `$k`, `id` (the copy ID
`v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`), `$v`, the copy metadata, then the item's own members.

`sha256` is taken over the canonical compact JSON of the item's own members, without `id` and the copy
metadata, so the copy's hash equals the published item's (EW-CORE-014).

Deserialisation reads the copy metadata itself and hands the remaining members to the item's own
deserialiser, so errors inside the item keep their paths (a flattened field would lose them).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

configured.description: The order code and components of a configured product (FR-PRT-006), beside [`PartKind::Configured`].

contacts.description: Contact data: the contacts of the part's contact image (FR-PRT-009).

item_id.description: The item's UUID, stable across versions.

library_id.description: The library's UUID (the project ID for project-local items).

sha256.description: Hash of the item's own members.

title: part
